purpose: 喵日记首次安装启动三屏引导设计
flow: 记录陪伴 → 日常照顾 → 建立档案；最后一屏进入现有首次建档流程；跳过入口结束介绍并进入建档或空状态首页。
design: 延续白底、深灰手绘线条、黄色主按钮、照片质感宠物抠图和白色贴纸描边。无手机外壳。仅设计稿，未接入应用。

screens.title: 每一天，都值得记住
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one finished high-fidelity mobile app onboarding screen, the FIRST of a consistent three-screen first-launch introduction for the Chinese pet diary app “喵日记”. Generate a SINGLE flat screen, portrait aspect ratio approximately 9:19.5 (match a 393×852 logical mobile viewport), high resolution with crisp Simplified Chinese typography. This is the app screen itself, edge-to-edge, no device frame, no presentation board, no surrounding border.

Visual system: bright pure WHITE background, near-black charcoal #30302e rounded bold Chinese UI type, warm sunflower yellow #FFDB68 primary color, small coral pink and sage green accents, warm off-white paper notes. Delightful restrained hand-drawn stationery aesthetic. Irregular thin charcoal contours for doodles and yellow buttons, tiny yellow emphasis strokes, gentle paper shadows. Main pets must be PHOTOREALISTIC cutout stickers with clear white die-cut borders and a very subtle gray shadow, real fine fur, natural anatomy, not cartoon pets, not 3D toys. A fluffy cream/brown blue-eyed ragdoll kitten and a small warm golden puppy match the brand. Plenty of white space and meticulous spacing; cute yet polished, not childish or cluttered.

Layout, exact positions shared by all three slides:
- A minimal phone status bar at the top (9:41, cellular, Wi-Fi, battery), no notch or device bezel.
- At about 9% screen height: small hand-drawn yellow paw followed by the small charcoal brand text “喵日记” at left; quiet gray “跳过” text button at right. Horizontal content margins about 24 logical px.
- The main sticker vignette occupies roughly 22% through 55% of screen height. A large lovable photographic ragdoll kitten on the left and a smaller photographic golden puppy on the right sit close together above a hand-drawn open diary with a soft-yellow bookmark. One small tilted Polaroid of the kitten, one tiny coral heart, one hand-drawn yellow camera and two yellow sparkle strokes suggest collecting memories. The vignette is isolated against white, with no enclosing box. Natural elegant composition, generous whitespace.
- Centered headline at about 63% screen height, large bold rounded dark Chinese, exactly: “每一天，都值得记住”
- Centered two-line supporting text beneath in medium gray, smaller and highly readable, exactly:
“照片、日记和小日常”
“把陪伴变成看得见的时光”
- Centered three pagination indicators at about 79% screen height: first a short yellow pill, second and third tiny light-gray circles.
- Near bottom, at 85%–92% screen height, a wide yellow primary button with subtly irregular rounded corners, thin 2px charcoal outline and a restrained charcoal offset bottom shadow. Label exactly “下一步” with a small right arrow at the far right. Button is within 24px side margins and about 54 logical pixels high.
- Bottom safe area with slim dark home indicator, generous space below the button.

All text must be accurately rendered in Simplified Chinese; include only the specified UI copy and status clock, no extra slogans or captions. No bottom tab bar, no login form, no permissions dialog, no statistics or badges, no gradients, no watermarks. The result should look like a thoughtful production-ready first-use onboarding screen for this existing stationery-style pet journal app.

screens.title: 照顾它，从容一点
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET: screen 1 of a Chinese pet diary app's first-launch onboarding. Transform it into screen 2 of the SAME onboarding set. Preserve the exact image dimensions, white background, app header, status bar, typography family and weight, margins, all text-area baselines, footer layout, primary-button size/shape/shadow, home indicator, color palette and photographic die-cut sticker style. Keep top-left “喵日记” with yellow paw, top-right “跳过”, and the status bar exactly as they are.

Replace ONLY the main hero vignette, headline, supporting copy and active pagination position:
1. Hero: a charming photorealistic blue-eyed cream-and-brown ragdoll kitten, matching the existing cat, sitting naturally beside a sage-green hand-drawn pet weighing scale. Around it, compose three restrained overlapping paper notes with rounded hand-drawn charcoal outlines, small yellow tape pieces and lots of breathing room. The notes contain clearly legible exact text: “喂食” with “08:30” and a yellow food-bowl icon; “体重” with “4.2 kg” and a small green scale icon; “护理” with “待办” and a coral comb icon. The cat is the dominant subject, cards support it without obscuring the face. Add a tiny yellow bell doodle and a single coral heart. Use exactly the hero region occupied by the pets and diary in screen 1. No enclosing panel or colored hero backdrop. The cat must look like a real photograph with fine natural fur and a white sticker cutout edge; objects are tasteful hand-drawn stationery.
2. Headline, exact: “照顾它，从容一点”
3. Supporting text, two centered lines, exact:
“喂食、体重、护理与待办”
“让每一份关心都有迹可循”
4. Pagination: first small light-gray circle, second active short yellow pill, third small light-gray circle. Keep the group centered at the exact same baseline.
5. Primary button still says exactly “下一步” with the same right arrow. All other chrome remains unchanged.

Maintain the same warm minimal design system, charcoal text, white background, yellow action button, coral and sage accent palette. Accurate Simplified Chinese. No bottom tab bar, no additional captions, no watermarks, no phone frame or presentation surround. Output exactly one complete second mobile onboarding screen.
